book.name: Luka
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Luka

content: Ukindendeke gwa Yecho uhuma kojhe

Lichiko limo Yecho patehila kubhola pa Nyumba jha Chapanga ku Yeluchalemo na kwalobholela bhando Lilobhe lya Mbone. Akapiya Matambiko bhakolongwa na bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo, na akanahota bha Kiyahude, bhakannyendile Yecho,
ngabhannobholila, “Bho, mutulobholele mihenga ilebhe henge kwa ukindendeke gwa ghane? Na ghane jwampekiye ukindendeke gwenio?”
Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Na nenga nipala kunkonya kilebhe chimo.
Bho, ukindendeke gwa Yohane gwa kubaticha bhando uhumila kojhe? Bho, ukindendeke gwenio uhumila kwa Chapanga amu kwa bhando?”
Nambo bhakalolakeine bhene kwa bhene, “Anda tulongi uhumita kwa Chapanga, natukonya, ‘Bho, nhwalo gwa nike mukannyeketi jhe Yohane?’
Anda tulongii uhumita kwa bhando, umanye lilongo lyoha nalitukoma kwa maghanga, nhwalo bhoha bhakamanye Yohane akibha chakaka ndi nnondole jwa Chapanga.”
Bhahe, bhakanyangwile, “Twenga tumanyite ndeka ukindendeke gwake kuhumile.”
Yecho ngabhalobholila, “Na namwete ninnobholela ndeka nihenga ghanga kwa ukindendeke gwa ghane.”
Nnandanikiho gwa ng'onda gwa michabibo na jwahilema

Yecho pajhendilila kwalobholela nnandanikiho ghonge, “Mundo jhumo akibhe na ng'onda gwake gwa michabibo. Na akabhajhahikiche bhubhalema, na jwenio akatumbuu mwanja ade ku kilambo chukutale, na kwenio ajhakutama kwa machiko ghamahele.

Pughahikita machiko gha kuhuna, mundo jwenio ajhakuntuma ntumiche gwake kwa bhubhalema bhala akatole mahuno gwa ng'onda gwake. Nambo bhubhalema bhala bhajhakuntyala ntumiche jhola na bhakammengite mabhoko matopo.
Nkolo nng'onda jhola ajhakuntuma helahela ntumiche jhonge. Nambo jwenio hele bhajhakuntyala na kuntendela ilebhe ya hone na kubhujhicha mabhoko matopo,
ajhakuntuma ntumiche jhonge jwa utato, na jwenio ndi bhajhakunkocholana na kumenga.
Peniya nkolo nng'onda jhola ajhakukikonya, ‘Ngohe nandenda bhole nenga? Nanintuma mwana gwango jwa pamwojho. Pange nabhanendema!’
Nambo bhubhalema bhala pubhamwenita, bhajhakupwepwelana jweniojho ndi nabhujhila mighonda, ‘Denda tunkome, na ng'onda gwake ubhehe gwito!’
Bhahe, bhajhakunhutila panja jha mighonda jha michabibo, bhajhakunkoma.” Bhahe, Yecho ajhakwakonya bho, nkolo ng'onda nabhatenda nike bhubhajhahike mighonda bhala?
“Nahika na kwakoma bhubhalema bhala, na kwapekeya bhange ng'onda gwenio.” Na bhando pubhajhohina ghenagha, bhajhakulonge, “Naha ndeka, gheniya ghakotoka kupitila!”
Nambo Yecho ajhakwalolekeya na kwakonya, “Bho, Majhandiko ghanga gha Chapanga mana jhake nike?

content.text: ngoheno ndi lighanga likolongwa lya nchinge!’

content: Mundo jhojhoha anda agwelile panane jha lighanga lyenio naheketwa imbembela imbembela, na lighanga lyenio anda ligwelikile mundo jhojhoha naliyogha yoghoyogho.”
Lilaghalikilo lya kupiya kode kwa Kaichale
Bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo na Akapiya matambiko bhakolo, bhapata bhankamulikii papa, nhwalo bhakamanye apiita nnandanikiho gwenio gwakochita kumwojho. Nambo bhajhogwipa bhando.
Bhahe, bhajhakupalaha lichaa lya mbone. Bhajhakwatuma bhando bhakitende bhaumbone kwa chwinda, bhanyonje Yecho kwa machwale, na bhahoto kunkamula na bhapeleke kwa munahota nkolongwa jwa ku Loma.
Bhando bhala bhajhakunkonya Yecho, “Mmola, tumanyite chimulongela na mibhola ilebhe ya uchakaka, hilu miningukiya ndeka mundo pamiho, nambo mibhola kwa uchakaka ndela jha Chapanga.
Bhahe, tunkonye, bhole yamaha amu yamaha ndeka kulepa kode kwa munahota nkolongwa jwa ku Loma liina lyake Kaichale?”
Nambo Yecho akamanye nginyika yabhe, ajhakwalobholela,
“Unangiye chente jha mbijha. Bho, chula jhenje na liina limulihwene lya ghane?” Ngabhanyangwila, “Ndi Kaichaile nkolongwa jwa ku Loma.”
Peniya Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Chikibhii cha nkolongwa jwa ku Loma munekele jwenio nkolongwa jwa ku Loma, na chikibhii cha Chapanga munekele jwenio Chapanga.”
Bhakannyonjite ndeka kwa lilobhe lyolyoha kuhumii palonge jha bhando. Na bhajhakukangachwa nako majhangulo ghake.
Libholo lya kuyoka
Machadukayo bhange, bhilongela bhubhawile nabhayoka ndeka, bhajhakunnyendelela Yecho na kunkonya,
“Mmola, Mucha akatujhandikile, ‘Anda nnongo jwa mundo awile na annekite nhwana mundo changa mwana, ipalwa nnongo mundo amujhila nawela jwenio, apapila yana nnongo mundo.’
Bhakibha akalongo mundo chaba. Jhola jwakutumbula ajhakubhujhila lipwela lela na paligha kuwegha changaleka mwana.
Jhubhele kubhelukwa, na jwenio ajhakumujhila lipwela lela, ajhakuwegha changa mwana hele,
Peniya jwa utato jhola ajhakumujhila lipwela lela, helahela akampapii jhe mwana, bhoha chaba bhakawile, changapapa yana.
Kukutila kwake, mwikeghe jhola na jwenio helahela ajhakujhomoka.
Ngohe bhole, machiko gha kuyokechwa pughapala kuhika, mwikeghe jwenio nabhaha nhwana gwa ghane? Nhwalo bhoha chaba bhakantolile.”
Yecho ngabhajhangwila, “Bhando bha nnema ghongo bhitolela na kutolelwa.
Nambo kwa bhala Chapanga abhabhone bhihoto kujhingii munnema ghuhika na muyokecho nabhatolela jhe amu kutolelwa.
Chakaka, nabhawe ndeka kabhele, nhwalo nabhalandana na akatumiche bha kunane kwa Chapanga, bheniya ndi yana ya Chapanga, nhwalo bhayokichwe kuhumii kubhawile.

Nambo kulonge kuyoka kwa bhando bhubhawile na bhene nabhayokichwa, Mucha akatulongalile mu Majhandiko gha Chapanga. Pa kiheghejha chikijhakita mwotu, ajhakulonge Bhambo Chapanga ngita, Chapanga jwa Ulahimo na Chapanga jwa Isaka na Chapanga jwa Yakobu.
Bhahe, jwenio Chapanga jwa bhando bhubhawile ndeka, nambo jwenio ndi Chapanga jwa bhando bhibhabhii na ughome nhwalo bhilama na jwenio.”
Bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo bhange bhajhakulonge, “Mmola, nnongii hotuhotu hake!”
Na bhene bhakajhighite jhe kunkonya machwale ghange.
Kilichitu mwana jwa ghane?
Peniya Yecho ajhakwakonya, “Bhando bhilonge bhole, Kilichitu ndi mwana gwa Daude?”
“Nhwalo Daude jwenio alongii mbone mukitabo chake cha Zabule,

content.text: ade nabheke makoko bhino pahe jha makongono ghino ngita kigoda cha kujheghemekeya makongono.’

content: Anda Daude ankema jwenio, ‘Bhambo,’ ngohe nahibhaha bhole Kilichitu kubhehe Mwana mundo?”
Yecho na bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo
Yecho ajhakwalobholela bhabholwa bhake, palonge jha bhando bhoha,

“Mukichunge na bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo, upala kupetapeta kongo bhakiwalile makanjo matandamaho na kujhambuchwa kwa kutembekewa mumaghuliho, na kutama migoda ya utembekeho munyumba jha kukonganikii Akayahude, helahela bhipala kutama migoda ya utembekeho ya muunyagho gwa kulyegha.
Na kwajhibhila akakeghe akanawela, na kukikopokeya kwa kukitenda bhaumbone, kongo bhakilangiya kwa bhando kunnyopa Chapanga kwa malobhe gha mahena. Bheniya nabhahadabulwa kupeta bhange!”
